title: security: RBAC v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Samira Patel
commits: rbacv2: add kms_region_pin enforcement check into authorization pipeline
audit: include kms_key_region and key_fingerprint in audit payloads
db: add kms_region_pin column to rbac_policies + migration
featureflag: add rollout gate for rbacv2.kms_region_pinning (canary)
docs: add RBAC v2 KMS region pinning guide and migration notes
tests: e2e + unit coverage for enforcement and audit entries
description:
Context: Customers operating in regulated environments require strict data residency guarantees tied to KMS usage. RBAC v2 allowed policy-level KMS key pinning in audit-only mode, but a production enforcement path and clear audit telemetry were missing. This PR implements enforcement mode for KMS region pinning in RBAC v2 and hardens audit logging to include KMS key fingerprint and region metadata so compliance teams can prove residency guarantees.

What this changes: adds a kms_region_pin boolean and allowed_regions list to RBAC policy model, enforces region checks in the authorization pipeline when the feature flag is enabled, and augments the audit payload with kms_key_id, kms_key_region, and key_fingerprint. Database migration script adds the column with backfill logic (existing policies default to audit-only). We add a feature flag (rbacv2.kms_region_pinning) with staged rollout: admin can run a migration and enable 'canary' for a subset of orgs before global enforcement.

Migration & rollout notes: run scripts/migrate_policies.sh to add the column and tag policies; start with feature flag in 'audit-only' mode to verify logs; enable canary for 5% of traffic and monitor audit events and auth latencies; when stable, flip enforcement for more orgs. Rollback: feature flag toggle and DB migration is additive (safe rollback: flip flag back to audit-only).

Testing: added unit tests for policy parsing and enforcement logic, e2e tests that simulate cross-region KMS requests and verify authorization decisions and audit entries, and CI integration pipeline updated to include RBAC/KMS matrix. Performance: measured median auth latency +1.8ms and 95th +3.6ms under a synthetic auth benchmark with enforcement enabled; added batching for KMS metadata lookups to mitigate cost.

Security & compliance: audit logs now contain stable key_fingerprint (SHA256) and region fields; logs are aliased to audit-store schema v2. Policy semantics documented in docs/security/rbac-v2-kms-region-pinning.md.

References: Linear ENG-5732, SEC-2211; support ticket SUP-9983 from compliance/customer security.

Checklist:

- [x] Audit payload additions and serializers

Commit summary and changed areas included above. This is aimed at a cautious staged rollout; recommend SRE/Observability to add a temporary alert for auth failure rate regressions during canary.
